node.statement: Four-term multiplicativity telescope. For fixed n and x,y in M_n tensor J, insert v_n(xy), v_n(x)v_n(y), and T_n(x)T_n(y) to obtain ||T_n(xy)-T_n(x) dot T_n(y)|| <= ||T_n(xy)-v_n(xy)|| + ||v_n(xy)-v_n(x)v_n(y)|| + ||v_n(x)v_n(y)-T_n(x)T_n(y)|| + ||T_n(x)T_n(y)-T_n(x) dot T_n(y)||. This uses only the ambient and compressed products already defined.
